description: Project-level module registry. Resources stay the truth-store owner; modules group those resources into daemon, client, shared, relay, release, and observability ownership boundaries before function-map or runtime refactor.

modules.responsibility: Top-level product runtime boundary across daemon, client, shared protocol, relay, release, and observability modules.
Daemon-side process, backend, mirror, transport subscriber, input, schedule, file, and remote-window runtime boundary.
Android client app shell, connection, session, channel, buffer, renderer, input, drawer, preview, remote-window overlay, and settings projection boundary.
Shared protocol, resource contracts, terminal types, connection types, and test contracts consumed by daemon and clients.
Relay account directory, signaling, public update route, and bounded peer-lease runtime boundary.
Build, package, promote, update, and installed runtime artifact boundary.
Debug side channel, architecture registry, test design, and governance gate boundary.
Wire daemon runtime modules, health/control routes, and process lifetime.

Own daemon endpoint discovery/publication, the persistent Relay host control connection, and physical client ingress from direct, Tailscale, WebRTC, and Relay routes; expose only terminal-channel subscriber interfaces inward.
Own backend session identity for tmux and WezTerm sources.
Own daemon canonical terminal rows, cols, cursor, revision, absolute index, capture, and reconciliation.
Own daemon physical body subscription eligibility, send accounting, backpressure, and bounded pending-latest state per terminal channel.
Own daemon input receive, stale/drop policy, retry ack/nack, dedupe, queueing, and backend write ordering.
Own daemon scheduled send rules, timers, next-fire calculation, dispatch, and result status.
Own daemon-derived tmux session idle/stopped classification and control-channel publication.
Own daemon file-transfer state and remote screenshot transfer handoff through backend session truth.

Own desktop app/window/iTerm2 catalog, coordinate manifests, ScreenCaptureKit capture, WebRTC sender, input helper, action injection, screenshot target manifests, cleanup, and design tracking for future remote-window canvas raw/layout/encode/focus resources.
Own Android platform terminal surface, page shell, navigation, and UI projection container.
Own shared phone and desktop pane layout profiles consumed by platform shell projections.
Own client-visible daemon target identity projection: named server, saved direct/Tailscale route candidates, relay directory candidates, and connection settings entry.
Own one client physical connection per daemon target, route health, open intent, and transport reuse. Application features use this interface instead of opening sockets.
Own current-process open-tab and active-session truth. It does not persist current tabs and does not own sockets.
Own per-session terminal-channel identity over the daemon-target physical transport.
Own bounded authoritative frame assembly, local sparse buffer apply by absolute row, and visible-range gap repair planning.
Own renderer visible range, follow/reading/renderBottomIndex, next-RAF commit, fixed-width crop, and DOM projection handoff.
Own platform input channel, IME anchor, QuickBar text/key intent, and terminal/remote-window input dispatch boundary.
Own reliable terminal input sequence allocation, ACK tracking, timeout retry, route-generation retry, and queue cleanup.
Own session drawer projection, ordered preview selection, preview mode, layout, body promotion, add/remove/replace, and cancel-to-entry projection.
Own Android remote-window picker/floating/fullscreen overlay projection, video receiver projection, touch/action classification, screenshot intent, bitrate UI, and IME/QuickBar avoidance.
Client file browsing, preview, selection, upload/download projection, and file-transfer intent boundary.
Settings projection for server profiles, config transfer, app update route candidates, and release/update install intent.
Own shared wire protocol request/response/error frame definitions used by daemon and clients.
Own machine-readable module/resource/edge review contracts and their static gates.
Shared terminal geometry, rows, buffer, and renderer-facing type contracts.
modules.owned_paths_note: android/src/lib entries are re-export shells over @zterm/shared plus client-local extensions (SessionBufferState layered type); wire truth lives in packages/shared.

modules.responsibility: Shared connection target, route candidate, route health, and selected route metadata contract.
Shared test-contract owners for resource, module, edge, function, and mainline gates.
Own independent per-login account tokens, role-scoped Relay control connection presence, account-scoped machine/daemon/endpoint/tmux-session directory, and public update route facts.
Own only idle-timeout bounded route/signaling peer leases keyed by account, daemon target, and concrete client device.
Own runtime home path and staged runtime state root.
Own APK/update/daemon release outputs and verifier-controlled promotion source.
Own deterministic staged daemon runtime artifact consumed by process start.
Own metadata-only diagnostics, runtime debug snapshots, trace summaries, and local evidence readers.
Own durable image attachment files, preview/original integrity, per-device delivery receipts, API enqueue/read, and 48-hour expiry cleanup.
